The '''Crown''' can be obtained from [[Hagwin Ironskull]] at [[Gunnar's Hold]] for 5 [[Bison Championship Token]]s. It has an [[Item's Attribute]] +1 bonus.

== Dye ==
{{dye chart}} 

== Notes ==
* Can be [[salvage]]d into about 40 [[Iron Ingot]]s or 3 [[Steel Ingot]]s.
* While the Crown is visible<!--Because you might equip and hide headgear-->, the [[character]]'s hair will disappear.

==Trivia==
* The Crown is often considered by players as the least expensive headgear piece in Eye of the North.
